name: dive_bomb_aim_heading_009c4f80
evidence: 009C4F80-009C5177, float __thiscall(state). Packet cc8_dive_geometry. The heading the two dive-bomb aim states steer on; NOT pose+C6Ch. Callers: exactly two, 009C51A8 (aimglide 009C5180) and 009C5935 (aimdive 009C58D0), tools/callsite_census.py exhaustive over rel32. Its result is arg0 of the 00438B10 at 009C5AA3 and at 009C5AF1 with the target bearing as arg1 (009C5A95 SUB ESP,8; 009C5A98 FSTP [ESP+4] the bearing; 009C5AA0 FSTP [ESP] the heading), so the roll interpolant's x is (aim heading - bearing). Branch bytes: 009C4FC6 is 76 48 JBE, so pitch <= 00CE7D1C (-0.6981317, -40 deg) takes the body-axis arm; 009C4FE3 is 0f 86 83 01 00 00 JBE, so only |pose+C68h| strictly past the pi/2 at 00CE3830 falls through to the 00438AA0 that adds the pi at 00D7A264. Steep arm: 0042D0D0 transforms (0,100,0) (00CE3D08) by the pose at +CCh and 009C505B atan2(out.z,out.x), 009C5068 FSUBR pi/2, 009C507C +2pi on a negative. 0042D0D0 is the row-vector form (out.x = in.x*m[0]+in.y*m[4]+in.z*m[8], 0042D0F2-0042D116), so (0,100,0) selects pose row 1, the body +Y axis, and the two arms agree because a 180 degree roll negates body +Y. SUBSTITUTION, labelled: the shallow arm's pose->vtable[50h] is stood in for by the cached Euler heading pose+C6Ch that 007C1900 writes. Bound in src/game_hosts_units.cpp's aimdive tick; before/after local/usn04_geo1.log and local/usn04_geo2.log. Documents: docs/DIVE_BOMB_TASK.md.

name: dive_bomb_aimglide_release_009c5777 gate chain
evidence: Packet cc8_dive_glide. The aimglide release gate chain 009C5689-009C5755, read from the listing with frame bases (SUB ESP,58h + PUSH EBX/EBP/ESI/EDI, canonical base 0x68). Six gates in order: (1) 009C5689 COMISS XMM2,[ESI+1Ch] with XMM2 zeroed at 009C562D, needs state+1Ch < 0, the 0.2..0.5 s rearm countdown 009C579E draws; (2) 009C569B needs |bearing error| < pi/6 (00CEC724), the bearing error being 009C53CA abs of 00438B10(pi/2 - atan2 of aimPoint-unit, 009C4F80 aim heading) - NOT a dive angle; (3) 009C56A6-009C56B8 needs release ceiling + 50.0 (00CE3938) > height above aim point; (4) 009C56BE-009C56FE needs |throw - range| < 120.0 (00D1F3F8); (5) 009C5743 needs lead < -5.0 (00D7A370); (6) 009C5755 needs lead > -4*travel - 5.0 (the 3.0 at 00D7A2B0 plus the bare travel). lead = [ESP+10h] - FCOS([ESP+18h]) * [ESP+14h] = range to the aim point minus the line-of-sight projection of the throw to approach+D8h, so it is negative on an overshoot and the window asks for a deliberate 5..(4*travel+5) m overshoot. Past all six, 009C575D-009C5784 drops min(007C1DB0(unit), 2) rounds - EBP is the literal 2 at 009C53DD - each one 007BBBA0 plus approach+2Ch -= 1.

name: dive_bomb_flyabove_altitude_009c6e10
abi: 009C6E10-009C6F91, the altitude arm inside BSP_BotStateDiveBombFlyAbove_Tick (009C62B0, void __thiscall(ECX = state)(float dt), RET 4). C = approach+0Ch ? ctl+398h : approach+ACh + approach+50h (009C6491 TEST, 009C64A6 74 JZ), clamped to (approach+14h)->+40h * approach+A8h when C > 1.1 * that (009C657C 76 JBE). It hands 009FB800 at 009C6F7D the altitude min(approach+ACh + approach+50h, C) and a reference: min(3*-err/max(A,1), 1.0) when err = B - min(approach+ACh, C) is negative (009C6EAF 76 JBE, 009C6EF5 77 JA); min(2A/max(A,1), 0.8) otherwise (009C6F51 76 JBE); and NO call at all when 0 <= err <= min(0.15*C, approach+B0h), where 009C6F89 writes cmd+2BCh = 0.0 with cmd+2D0h = 2 (009C6F15 76 JBE). A is the planar distance to the aim point built at 009C6379-009C63A6; B is 009C6493's height above it. EDI is state+4h from the single write 009C62C7 LEA EDI,[ESI+4]. Constants at load width: 00CE3DF0 qword 1.1, 00CE6618 qword 0.15, 00D7A2B0 qword 3.0, 00D7A24C MOVSS 1.0, 00CE74F8 MOVSS 0.8, 00CE3D40 qword 0.8. With this installation's SPNormal row the clamp is 210 m. docs/DIVE_BOMB_TASK.md, reports/dive_bomb_flyabove_altitude.json.
